title: Proactive headroom predictor failure & customer escalation runbook
creator: Priya Menon
description: Production incident: the proactive headroom predictor (online model used by the Dedicated autoscaler to forecast burst demand) regressed after a feature rollout, causing underprovisioning of reserved pools and multiple customer escalations for soft quota / cold starts. This ticket captures the immediate runbook, communications, and the engineering fixes (short and long term).
reproduction_steps: 1) Deploy predictor model v2.1 with feature flags enabled in staging
2) Replay traffic profile 'weekend-microburst' from prod-telemetry into staging loadgen
3) Observe headroom prediction error: predicted_headroom < actual_peak by >40% over 5m window
4) Trigger autoscaler simulation using predicted_headroom to show reserved pool scale-up failure
investigation_summary: Telemetry shows a systematic underestimation by the new predictor after the rollout on 2025-02-11 03:10 UTC. Root cause factors identified: (A) feature 'short-session-trim' changed request feature distribution; (B) model retraining did not include the most recent microburst pattern due to late telemetry schema change; (C) a gating check in the autoscaler misinterpreted negative confidence values as low variance and suppressed emergency headroom allocations. Correlation with customer reports indicates Tier-1 customers hit coldstarts between 2025-02-11 03:30 and 06:00 UTC.
temporary_mitigation: 1) Rollback predictor rollout to v2.0 in production (completed 2025-02-12 05:12 UTC). 2) Enable manual headroom override (+25% buffer) for affected reserved pools for 72 hours. 3) Add emergency route to fallback capacity controller (always-on conservative estimator). 4) Customer comms: sent targeted update to top 8 affected tenants with mitigations and ETA.
permanent_action_items: 1. Add regression tests: incorporate recent microburst traces into training and CI replay suite (owner: infra-ml).
2. Fix autoscaler gating: treat negative confidence as missing data, not low variance (owner: autoscaler-team).
3. Implement canary + shadowing for predictor model rollouts (owner: serving-runtime).
4. Add explicit telemetry schema validation step before model retrain ingestion (owner: observability).
5. Create a fast-path emergency buffer toggle in Console for SRE/SEs (owner: console-team).
rollout_plan: Phased rollout: A) deploy autoscaler gating fix to canary region and run repro replay (2025-03-06), B) run shadow predictor v2.2 for 48h against production (no allocation effects) and compare predictions to conservative estimator (2025-03-08), C) if shadow results show <5% error vs actual, enable canary rollout to 5% tenants then 25% then 100% with metric gates for coldstart rate and latency SLA (owner: Carlos Rivera).
monitoring_and_alerting: New alerts added: headroom_prediction_bias > 20% sustained for 10m, reserved_pool_fill_time > SLA threshold, coldstart_rate per-tenant > 0.5% over 15m. Dashboards: new 'Headroom Predictor Health' panel with bias histogram and cohort breakdown (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/1345).
comments: 2025-02-12 Priya Menon: Created ticket after rollback and immediate mitigation; captured customer notes from CS. Next: attach replay traces and request SRE to hold buffer override.

2025-02-13 Carlos Rivera: Started root cause triage with autoscaler and ML teams. Found mismatch in feature encoding between training pipeline and online feature store. Assigned infra-ml to regenerate dataset.
2025-02-18 Mei-Ling Zhou (SRE): Emergency buffer override applied to region-eu-west for customers: AcmeHealth, FinLedger. Observed coldstarts drop to baseline within 18 minutes.
2025-02-25 Jamal Carter (PM): Reviewed trade-offs between conservative estimator and improved predictor. PM prefers implementing canary shadowing + telemetry gating before global rollout.

2025-03-01 Engineering review: Decision to implement autoscaler gating fix and telemetry validation as high-priority; autoscaler PR #998 opened for review. Requested performance bench results from runtime team.
2025-03-04 Carlos Rivera: Updated ticket with rollout plan and monitoring changes. Blocker cleared: infra-ml provided retrained model v2.2 candidate and CI replay success in staging.
